A small browser toolkit

One bookmark. One useful job.

11 tools for everyday tasks. Drag a button to your bookmarks bar, then run it on the page you're working on.

Drag to install →

Show your bookmarks bar with Ctrl + Shift + B in Chrome or Edge on Windows. Drag a green button below onto the bar. Clicking it here shows instructions.

01

⬇ Logo Grab

Finds the current site's favicon or app icon, prioritises SVG and larger declared sizes, and downloads a square PNG.

⬇ Logo Grab

Open the website you want an icon from, then run Logo Grab. The PNG is named after the site's hostname.

Details and manual installation

Uses icons declared by the page, rather than searching page content for a brand logo. The PNG is at least 256 × 256 pixels; enlarging a small icon does not add detail. If CORS prevents export, it shows the original image for manual saving in its original format.

Readable source

02

Passphrases

Creates a three-word passphrase with punctuation, varied initial capitalisation and a two-digit number, then copies it to the clipboard.

Passphrases

Run on a normal webpage. A notification shows the generated passphrase; if copying fails, a prompt lets you copy it manually.

Details and manual installation

Retains the supplied wordlists, format and Math.random-based generation algorithm. Generates locally without a server request; the notification displays the passphrase on the current page for five seconds.

Readable source · Original project

03

Halo link

Copies a formatted hyperlink to the open Halo ticket, using its ticket number and summary as the link text.

Halo link

Open a ticket in the Halo agent interface, run Halo link, then paste into an application that supports rich text, such as Outlook or Teams.

Details and manual installation

Requires the expected ticket number and summary elements and an id URL parameter. Plain-text destinations may discard the hyperlink formatting; Halo interface changes may require selector updates.

Readable source

04

TidyRhea

Adds a collapse/expand button to Rhea's sidebar, giving forms more space and remembering the sidebar preference in this browser.

TidyRhea

Open Rhea, run TidyRhea, then use the arrow button to toggle the sidebar. Running the bookmarklet again also toggles it.

Details and manual installation

Only runs on rhea.private.aus-1.datixcloudiq.com. The preference is stored in that site's local storage. Re-run after a full page reload to restore the control and saved preference.

Readable source

05

🪟 Window Resizer

Opens the current page in a new window at a preset size or custom width and height.

🪟 Window Resizer

Run on the page you want to resize. Choose 1280 × 720, 1366 × 768 or 1920 × 1080, or enter custom dimensions.

Details and manual installation

Requests whole-window dimensions in CSS pixels, including the title bar and borders. Browser and operating-system limits may adjust the actual size. Allow pop-ups for the current site when prompted.

Readable source

06

Table to Excel

Copies a loaded HTML table into Excel or downloads it as a tab-separated file, expanding merged cells.

Table to Excel

Choose a table from the list or use Pick a table on the page. Copy for Excel includes HTML and plain text where supported; Download TSV exports a UTF-8 tab-separated file.

Details and manual installation

Exports loaded rows only, not unseen pages or unloaded virtual rows. Hidden rows are excluded by default. Formula-like text is treated as text by default; this can be disabled. Merged continuation cells are blank. Virtual grids and canvas tables may not expose a usable HTML table.

Readable source

07

Clean text

Converts selected or pasted text to clean plain text, normalising spaces and tidying blank lines.

Clean text

Select text before running, or paste into Input. Choose whether to remove repeated blank lines or join all lines into one paragraph, then copy the result.

Details and manual installation

Normalises non-breaking spaces, removes zero-width spaces and trims line edges. Original webpage content is not edited. Plain-text copying removes rich formatting.

Readable source

08

Screenshot tidy

Automatically covers detectable email addresses, likely phone numbers and names in labelled fields or columns, with manual cover controls.

Screenshot tidy

Run before taking a screenshot. Review the automatic masks, add any extra names one per line, or use Click to cover for missed details. Hide controls for 15 seconds while capturing. Escape, Restore page or running it again removes the masks.

Details and manual installation

Detection is heuristic: unlabelled names, split text, images, canvas content and embedded frames may be missed, and some numeric IDs may look like phone numbers. Names found in labelled inputs or table columns are also matched elsewhere on the page. Masks are opaque display overlays; underlying page data remains. Review the full intended screenshot before sharing.

Readable source

09

Text toolkit

Provides URL and UTF-8 Base64 encoding/decoding, JSON formatting/compacting and GUID generation in a local panel.

Text toolkit

Select text before running or paste into Input. Choose an operation and click Run. Copy output or use it as the next input. Generate GUID creates a random UUID v4.

Details and manual installation

No data is sent to an external service. URL decoding treats + as a literal plus, rather than form-encoded space. Standard Base64 is supported. JSON uses the native parser, so duplicate keys and numbers beyond JavaScript numeric precision require care.

Readable source

10

UTC converter

Converts timestamps between UTC and Melbourne time, handling AEST/AEDT and daylight-saving transitions.

UTC converter

Enter YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm[:ss], an ISO timestamp with Z or a numeric offset, or a 10-digit Unix-seconds / 13-digit Unix-milliseconds timestamp. Choose UTC or Melbourne for input without an offset, then convert.

Details and manual installation

Explicit offsets override the input-zone choice. Invalid dates and nonexistent Melbourne wall times are rejected. When clocks move back, an ambiguous Melbourne time requires an earlier/later choice. Output includes UTC, Melbourne with its offset, and Unix timestamps.

Readable source

11

Field inspector

Inspects a clicked page element and copies its CSS selector or field metadata, including labels, ID, name and accessibility attributes.

Field inspector

Choose Pick element, then click a field, label or wrapper. Copy selector for CSS work, or Copy details for the JSON metadata. Escape stops picking; Close removes the tool and highlight.

Details and manual installation

Inspects the clicked element, which may be a wrapper rather than the actual input. Generated selectors use IDs where unique and structural selectors otherwise. Selectors inside an open shadow root are scoped to that root. Closed shadow roots and embedded frames are not traversed.

Readable source

Can't drag? Copy a bookmarklet URL and paste it into a bookmark's URL field. Bookmarklets run in the active page; browser pages and restrictive site policies can block them.
